xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #6477

plan.title: bug(design-critique): arcs accepted before the harvest-digest rule cannot be ingested; grandfather unedited leans

narratives.Description: Since 0.129.11 (#6333) a clean pain-audit counts for a lean with an Acceptance Criteria list or a Slices section only when it carries a harvest-digest line equal to the lean's current harvest, so every arc accepted before that rule fails issue:ingest and verify:ac with unresolved-pain-audit. This story grandfathers a digestless audit when the lean comment's updated_at is strictly before the audit comment's created_at, both read from the same GitHub REST comment rows as the hashed bodies. An edited lean, a digest-bearing audit, a missing or malformed timestamp, and a plain lean with no acceptance criteria or slices stay on today's rule; there is no release-date cutoff, no new gate, no new fetch and no consumer step.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer or consumer with design arcs accepted before the harvest-digest rule, I want issue:ingest and verify:ac to count their clean digestless audits when the lean was not edited after the audit, so that those arcs can be built without a hand re-audit that would open a later arc.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/design-critique/pain-audit-follow-through-gate.ts: ThreadCommentLike gains optional created_at and updated_at; auditCountsForLean takes the audit and lean comments and adds one true-arm: no harvest-digest carrier, lean has Acceptance Criteria or Slices, both instants are strings matching YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.fraction]Z, and lean updated_at is strictly before audit created_at. The plain-lean arm and the bad-digest non-count are unchanged; no release cutoff.
2. packages/core/src/design-critique/completed-arc-record.ts: ThreadComment gains the two optional fields and threadCommentsFromIssueComments copies them from the same REST row (feeds the design-critique chip and stale-ready).
3. packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.ts threadCommentsFromIssue and packages/core/src/intake/spec-path-source.ts fetchSpecPathSourceComments copy created_at and updated_at from the same row as the body.
4. Tests: gate unit tests for every timestamp shape (pain-audit-follow-through-gate.test.ts), mapper tests (completed-arc-record.test.ts, design-critique-chip.test.ts), ingest end-to-end (issue-ingest.test.ts) and verify:ac Spec-path parity (spec-path-source.test.ts).
5. changelog.d/6477-grandfather-digestless-audits.md.
narratives.Overview:
- A digestless pain-audit counts for a lean that has an Acceptance Criteria list or a Slices section only when both timestamps come from the same REST comment row as the hashed body, both match YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS with optional fraction and a trailing Z, and the lean updated_at is strictly before the audit created_at.
- Missing, empty, null, non-string, equal, later, and any other timestamp shape do not count, and the check reads neither the comment body, nor the issue updated_at, nor a scanned body joined to a different row.
- issue:ingest, the design-critique chip, and verify:ac each copy created_at and updated_at from that same REST row into the follow-through input.
- A digestless audit of a lean with neither an Acceptance Criteria list nor a Slices section still counts with no timestamp check, and a present harvest-digest line that is not a sha256 digest still does not count.
- The grandfather does not consult the release instant of the digest rule.

## Acceptance Criteria


- Given an accepted arc whose clean pain-audit has no harvest-digest line and whose lean updated_at is strictly before that audit created_at, both timestamps being UTC instants from the same REST rows, when issue:ingest runs, then the audit counts and ingest proceeds.
- Given the same arc whose lean updated_at is equal to or later than that audit created_at, when issue:ingest runs, then it refuses as today.
- Given an audit that carries a harvest-digest line, then it is judged exactly as today.
- Given a missing or unreadable lean or audit timestamp on a lean that has acceptance criteria or slices, then the digestless audit does not count.
- verify:ac on an unlanded Spec-path brief applies the same timestamp rule as issue:ingest.

```quarantined
role: critic
```

audit-targets: none

Round-1 refutation of Stop 1 comment 6936108952. The premise holds: an unedited lean has an unchanged harvest, because the harvest is a pure function of that comment's body. The target can bind after the statement changes in F1–F3. Do not add a release cutoff (F4).

Pin: `a21a1802d22c79768e8e88491fe2ad45cd9c156f`. This worktree's host hook denied `git show` (missing runtime pin). The cited gate text matches the raw blob at that SHA. The arc-6477 checkout HEAD file, and its only reflog entry, are that SHA. Stop 1 body is REST comment 6936108952. Comments after that id were not read.

### F1 — strict-before, same REST row
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `auditCountsForLean` (`packages/core/src/design-critique/pain-audit-follow-through-gate.ts` 306–315) counts a null `harvest-digest` carrier only when the lean has no Acceptance Criteria list and no Slices. A matching digest counts. A present but invalid carrier does not. `hashHarvestIdentity` (246–268) hashes only that body: bound-remedy titles and positions, acceptance-criteria titles and positions, slices lines. `ThreadCommentLike` (86–89) and `ThreadComment` (`completed-arc-record.ts` 48–51) carry id and body, so the gate cannot see timestamps. `IssueComment` (`issue-ingest.ts` 179–188) already has optional `created_at` and `updated_at`. `persistableIssueComment` copies those strings (1453–1457) and runs the quarantine scan on the body only (1442), so the persisted body is not the raw REST body. GitHub comment `updated_at` moves when the comment is edited and does not move for a reaction. The clock is whole seconds. "Not later" is `<=`.
Failure mode: a lean edit and an audit in the same UTC second compare equal, so the audit counts against a body it may not have observed. A body line that spells those field names, or a join of `plan.metadata` timestamps onto a different body, admits a changed harvest. `Date.parse` of a naive or date-only string can order the pair the wrong way. Treating a missing `updated_at` as `created_at` reads "unreadable" as "never edited."
Disposition: for this exception only, both instants must come from the same REST comment row as the body that is hashed, both must match `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.fraction]Z`, and the lean's `updated_at` must be strictly before the audit's `created_at`. Missing, empty, null, non-string, equal, later, and any other shape do not count. Do not parse those names out of the body. Do not use the issue's `updated_at`. Do not overlay the persisted scanned thread onto a live body.
Road not taken: GraphQL `userContentEdits` / `lastEditedAt`. REST issue comments do not carry that field, and this pass adds no new fetch. It would flip if REST `updated_at` moved with no body change. A reaction does not; a body edit does.

### F2 — keep the pair on every gate input
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `threadCommentsFromIssue` (`issue-ingest.ts` 2190–2201) drops both fields after `enrichIssueWithComments` attaches the live REST array (2064–2077; `fetchIssue` 2114–2129 always refetches comments). `threadCommentsFromIssueComments` (`completed-arc-record.ts` 1666–1675) drops them again. The chip (`design-critique-chip.ts` 196–197) and stale-ready (`design-critique-stale-ready.ts` 142–143) feed the gate through that second mapper. `fetchSpecPathSourceComments` (`spec-path-source.ts` 340–343) keeps `{id, body}` from the REST row, and `fetchSpecPathLiveIdentities` (353–362) is the `verify:ac` resolver. The gate itself is `evaluateAccumulatedPainAuditFollowThrough`, called from `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` (1135), which refuses with `unresolved-pain-audit` when no targeting audit counts (498–519).
Failure mode: fixing only the mapper Stop 1 names lets `issue:ingest` count the grandfather while `verify:ac`, and the chip and stale-ready fetches, still have no timestamps. F1 then fail-closes those paths, so the second pain stays refused and a chip proof of the same thread still reports unresolved-pain-audit.
Disposition: copy `created_at` and `updated_at` from the same REST row in all three builders. One predicate then serves ingest, the chip, and `verify:ac`.

### F3 — one extra true-arm, not a new wrapper
sharpens-framing
Evidence: the null-carrier arm already returns true when the lean has neither list (`auditCountsForLean` 311–312). `hashHarvestIdentity` keeps `hashBoundRemedyBytes` for that lean so earlier arcs do not move (241–244). A bad digest line is `{ok:false}` (`extractOperativeHarvestDigest` 291–297) and does not count (314). Stop 1 says this change loosens one check, and digest-bearing audits stay on today's rule.
Failure mode: wrapping every digestless result in the timestamp check refuses a plain lean whose comments have no timestamps, and refuses a plain lean edited after a digestless audit. Both count today. Treating `{ok:false}` as absent lets a non-hash `harvest-digest` line grandfather an Acceptance Criteria lean.
Disposition: add one arm. Null carrier and the lean has an Acceptance Criteria list or Slices, then the F1 test. Leave `return !leanHasAcceptanceOrSlices` with no timestamp. Leave `{ok:false}` and a non-matching digest as non-counts.

### F4 — no release-instant cutoff
footnote
Evidence: `[0.129.11] - 2026-11-16` shipped the digest rule (`CHANGELOG.md` 19). The count rule's stated purpose is staleness, the recorded digest equals the current harvest (`auditCountsForLean` 301–304), not the calendar date of the audit.
Failure mode: a cutoff at that release instant false-refuses a consumer who accepted an arc on a pre-0.129.11 pin after 2026-11-16. That is the population the issue says must be grandfathered with no action. The digest is not an authenticator. A reader of the lean can paste the sha256.
Disposition: do not add it. The F1 comparison is the whole staleness proof. Road not taken: cutoff at the 0.129.11 publish instant. It would flip if the goal were a positive digest act on every new audit rather than staleness. That is a different rule, and a global clock cannot separate "old pin, after the release" from "new pin, omitted digest" without stored state this pass does not add.

metadata.issueBody:
## Problem

#6333 (released in 0.129.11) made a pain-audit count for a lean that has an Acceptance Criteria list or Slices only when the audit carries an operative `harvest-digest:` line equal to the lean's current harvest digest (`packages/core/src/design-critique/pain-audit-follow-through-gate.ts`). Audits posted before that rule have no such line. So every arc accepted before the rule can no longer be ingested: `issue:ingest` refuses with "unresolved-pain-audit … a digestless audit does not count", and `verify:ac` fails the same check for an unlanded Spec-path brief.

This hits this repository today and will hit every consumer that upgrades with accepted, not-yet-built arcs. The only current remedy is a hand re-audit per issue.

## Evidence (2026-11-16, runtime 0.129.11)

Three accepted arcs refused at ingest, each with a clean audit and an unedited lean:
- #6372: lean 6908175115 (created and last updated 05:26:59Z), clean audit 6908204634 (05:28:57Z), no digest line.
- #6374: lean 6922085862, clean audit 6922135477, no digest line.
- #6375: lean 6922277372, no digest line.
#6187 (an older arc whose audit form passed) was admitted.

## Candidate (operator decision 2026-11-16: file and queue a hotfix)

Grandfather digestless audits with GitHub's own timestamps: a clean pain-audit without a `harvest-digest:` line counts when the bound lean comment has not been edited since the audit was posted (lean `updated_at` is not later than the audit's `created_at`). If the lean was edited after the audit, it does not count, as today. Audits that carry a digest line are judged as today. The rule's purpose (an audit must cover the lean's current harvest) holds, because an unedited lean has an unchanged harvest. No new step, flag or stored state; consumers need to do nothing.

Open points for a short design pass: whether to also require the audit to predate the release that shipped #6333; how a missing or unreadable `updated_at` fails (it should fail closed, as today).

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given an accepted arc whose clean pain-audit has no harvest-digest line and whose lean comment was not edited after that audit, when `issue:ingest` runs, then the audit counts and ingest proceeds.
- Given the same arc whose lean comment was edited after the audit, when `issue:ingest` runs, then it refuses as today.
- Given an audit that carries a harvest-digest line, then it is judged exactly as today.
- Given an unreadable lean or audit timestamp, then the digestless audit does not count.
- `verify:ac` on an unlanded Spec-path brief applies the same rule.

admitted_source_sentences: A digestless pain-audit counts for a lean that has an Acceptance Criteria list or a Slices section only when both timestamps come from the same REST comment row as the hashed body, both match YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS with optional fraction and a trailing Z, and the lean updated_at is strictly before the audit created_at.

Missing, empty, null, non-string, equal, later, and any other timestamp shape do not count, and the check reads neither the comment body, nor the issue updated_at, nor a scanned body joined to a different row.
issue:ingest, the design-critique chip, and verify:ac each copy created_at and updated_at from that same REST row into the follow-through input.

A digestless audit of a lean with neither an Acceptance Criteria list nor a Slices section still counts with no timestamp check, and a present harvest-digest line that is not a sha256 digest still does not count.
The grandfather does not consult the release instant of the digest rule.

Given an accepted arc whose clean pain-audit has no harvest-digest line and whose lean updated_at is strictly before that audit created_at, both timestamps being UTC instants from the same REST rows, when issue:ingest runs, then the audit counts and ingest proceeds.
Given the same arc whose lean updated_at is equal to or later than that audit created_at, when issue:ingest runs, then it refuses as today.
Given an audit that carries a harvest-digest line, then it is judged exactly as today.
